waves.goal: Survive this Wave to reach Gaia.

pages.wave1_intro: Mr. Aguilar's map leads you into the mist. Before long, the air fills with a furious buzzing - a great bear lumbers out of the fog, a nest of Venena fused to its back.
pages.wave1_intro_ability_rules: Strength: each time the enemy counterattacks, afterwards add a monster token to its tile. Add its count of monster tokens to its damage. Fatal Flaw: these enemies can only be killed in the order specified next to this ability - enemies labelled "Fatal Flaw: 1" must die first, then "Fatal Flaw: 2", and so on. They can still suffer damage in any order; only the final point of damage is gated.
pages.q6_w1_end: The last of the Venena falls silent. Do you press on through the mist, or turn back?
pages.q6_w1_defeat: The creatures swarm you and you black out. Your Quest is ended.
pages.q6_w1_continue:
You spot the ruins of Second Nest, where a deluge beats down on the area. The hidden cache is said to be at the edge of town, though rumors say the area is infested with creatures. To make matters worse, the heavy rain hampers your visibility and movement. You ready yourselves and move in.

Delvers gain 2 elements (your choice).
pages.q6_w1_retreat:
The marked building is just ahead, but pain slows every step and your strength is fading fast. Pushing forward now would be reckless. You turn back, leaving the ruins and their secrets for another attempt.

Your Quest is ended.
pages.q6_w2_end: The last Snatcher goes still in the rain. The marked building stands before you.
pages.q6_w2_defeat: The creatures swarm you and you black out. Your Quest is ended.
pages.q6_w2_retreat:
After slaying the last of the Snatchers, you enter the building. It appears to have been an armory at one time or other. Most of it is picked over, but after a thorough search, you find a deadly looking blade behind a false wall.

Add Shop Product #43 to your Purchasable Products. Your Quest is complete!
pages.q6_w2_continue:
After slaying the last of the Snatchers, you enter the building. It appears to have been an armory at one time or other. Most of it is picked over, but after a thorough search, you find a deadly looking blade behind a false wall. That's when your eyes spot a small campsite in the corner of the hidden wall. Someone tried to make the area comfortable with two sleeping bags, a firepit dug into the dirt, and several containers of dried food.

A note with a single message was left on top of the container: "Take something, leave something."

You decide to rest for a bit, lighting the fire for warmth against the icy chill of the storm blowing outside. With the glow of the fire, your eyes glimpse something on the wall. Names, hundreds of them, along with the date they were each written. You recognize some of the names, including Jonah Stone and Margaret Woo. They must have stopped here on their way to Gaia decades ago.

You stand and add your name to the list, a symbol that you were here; that you were aided by those that came before you and left something behind for whoever comes after. Looking at the hundreds of names, you suddenly don't feel so alone.

Add Shop Product #43 to your Purchasable Products. Your Quest is complete!

You're determined to carry on. This time you'll reach Gaia. Delvers gain a Level card.
pages.q6_w3_end: The Abomination topples and the Blackguards fall silent among the ruins.
pages.q6_w3_defeat: The creatures swarm you and you black out. Your Quest is ended.
pages.q6_w3_continue:
You press on through the ruins, determination overriding exhaustion - this time, you will reach Gaia. The path ahead is brutal, but you refuse to falter.

Delvers gain a Level card.
pages.q6_w3_retreat: The Blackguards leave you battered and drained, every delver suit system on the brink of failure. The path forward promises only more of the same and you've reached your limit.
pages.q6_w4_end: The Golem grinds to a halt amid the shattered Orites.
pages.q6_w4_defeat: The creatures swarm you and you black out. Your Quest is ended.
pages.q6_w4_continue:
As you press on through the wreckage with weakening will, Witness suddenly bobs ahead and dramatically "points" toward Gaia, then trips over a loose chunk of debris. You can't help but snort as he rights himself and carries on as if nothing happened. If this goof can carry on, so can you.

Delvers heal 4 HP.
pages.q6_w4_retreat: The Golem's blows leave you reeling, systems failing faster than you can recover. Witness hovers beside you, lets out a long, disappointed beeeep, then slowly turns and drifts back, pausing just long enough to make sure you're following. You sigh and fall in behind him, retreating before the Tide claims you both.
pages.q6_w5_end: The Timber Fiend crashes down and its brood falls still. Gaia's glow spills over the ridge ahead.
pages.q6_w5_defeat: The creatures swarm you and you black out. Your Quest is ended.
pages.q6_w5_gaia:
You step into the glow of the massive hovering structure that is Gaia. Witness deposits a large heap of metal on the ground, then looks at you and mimes closing their eyes tightly - eventually you understand that you should do the same. Even with your eyes clamped shut, you're blinded by Gaia's consecration. Over several minutes, though, your sight gradually returns, and you are delighted to see that the metal glows with its own inner light.

Shop Products #32-45: choose any 2 products to add to your Purchasable Products.
pages.q6_w4_woo:
As you press on through the wreckage with weakening will, Witness suddenly bobs ahead and dramatically "points" toward Gaia, then trips over a loose chunk of debris. You can't help but snort as he rights himself and carries on as if nothing happened. If this goof can carry on, so can you.

Headmistress Arlen's voice comes through your comms. "Delvers, would you mind a small detour? There's a cache of equipment hidden nearby that my students would benefit from greatly."

Margaret Woo's diary describes this last stretch: "a ridge of broken towers, then the light." Her notes mark a cache wedged beneath a fallen beam, still sealed after twenty years. Inside lies a war mace of the old world, its haft etched with the names of delvers long gone.

Add Shop Product #44 War Mace to your Purchasable Products. Both delvers heal 4 HP.

Through the downpour drifts a paper festival lantern, its candle sheltered under the folds. A name is written on its side - someone set it loose for the Memorial.

It leads you to a sheltered doorway and a previous delver's cache.

You ready yourselves and move in.

Gain a LEVEL UP card. Both delvers gain 2 ELEMENTS of their choice.
